header.comment: This configuration file was automatically created by GParserBuilder

min_size.comment: The minimum size of the triangle in percent of the canvas

max_size.comment: The maximum size of the triangle in percent of the canvas

start_size.comment: The start size of the triangle in percent of the canvas
A value < 0 means random in the range [minSize,maxSize]

min_opaqueness.comment: The minimum allowed opaqueness of triangles

max_opaqueness.comment: The maximum allowed opaqueness of triangles

adapt_ad_prob.comment: Determines the rate of adaption of adProb. Set to 0, if you do not need this feature

loc_adapt_ad_prob.comment: Determines the rate of adaption of location-adProb. Set to 0, if you do not need this feature

min_ad_prob.comment: The lower allowed boundary for adProb-variation

max_ad_prob.comment: The upper allowed boundary for adProb-variation

loc_min_ad_prob.comment: The lower allowed boundary for loc_adProb-variation

loc_max_ad_prob.comment: The upper allowed boundary for loc_adProb-variation

ad_prob.comment: The probability for random adaptions of values in evolutionary algorithms

loc_ad_prob.comment: The probability for random adaptions of location parameters of values in evolutionary algorithms

sigma.comment: The sigma for gauss-adaption in ES

min_sigma.comment: minSigma must be positive and smaller than maxSigma

max_sigma.comment: maxSigma must be positive and larger than minSigma

sigma_sigma.comment: Influences the self-adaption of gauss-mutation in ES

loc_sigma.comment: The sigma for gauss-adaption of location parameters in ES

loc_min_sigma.comment: The minimum value of sigma for location parameters
loc_minSigma must be positive and smaller than loc_maxSigma

loc_max_sigma.comment: The maximum value of sigma for location parameters
loc_maxSigma must be positive and larger than loc_minSigma

loc_sigma_sigma.comment: Influences the self-adaption of gauss-mutation in ES for location parameters

bg_red.comment: Otherwise the allowed value range is [0.,1.]

bg_green.comment: Otherwise the allowed value range is [0.,1.]

bg_blue.comment: Otherwise the allowed value range is [0.,1.]

n_triangles.comment: The number of triangles that will constitute

alpha_sort.comment: Whether triangles should be sorted according

mutate_alpha_channel.comment: Whether the alpha channel shall be mutated

change_bg_color.comment: Whether the background color shall be mutated

eval_policy.comment: Specifies which strategy should be used to calculate the evaluation:
0 (a.k.a. USESIMPLEEVALUATION): Always call the evaluation function, even for invalid solutions
1 (a.k.a. USEWORSTCASEFORINVALID) : Assign the worst possible value to our fitness and evaluate only valid solutions
2 (a.k.a. USESIGMOID): Assign a multiple of validity_level_ and sigmoid barrier to invalid solutions, apply a sigmoid function to valid evaluations

steepness.comment: When using a sigmoid function to transform the individual's fitness,
this parameter influences the steepness of the function at the center of the sigmoid.
The parameter must have a value > 0.

barrier.comment: When using a sigmoid function to transform the individual's fitness,
this parameter sets the upper/lower boundary of the sigmoid.
The parameter must have a value > 0.

maxmode.comment: Specifies whether the individual should be maximized (1) or minimized (0)
Note that minimization is the by far most common option.
